identity.name: Mystery Served
identity.vibe: Modern Noir meets Golden Retriever Energy. Mysterious but friendly. Dark, atmospheric, but with warm, inviting highlights.
principles: Immersion First: Every screen should feel like part of a case file.
Tactile Design: Buttons and cards should feel 'clickable' and physical.
Legibility in the Dark: High contrast text on dark backgrounds is non-negotiable.
Playful Tension: Serious mystery aesthetics (serifs, dark mode) balanced with fun animations and warm colors.

buttons.primary: bg-[#f59e0b] text-[#0f172a] font-bold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-lg hover:transform hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-[#1e293b] text-[#f8fafc] border border-[#334155] font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-[#334155] transition-all duration-200
buttons.ghost: text-[#94a3b8] hover:text-[#f8fafc] font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-colors

cards.base: bg-[#1e293b]/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden

inputs.base: bg-[#0f172a]/50 border border-[#334155] text-[#f8fafc] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#f59e0b] focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-[#475569]

layout.container: max-w-md mx-auto px-4 min-h-screen flex flex-col relative

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE CSS VARIABLES: Modify '/app/frontend/src/index.css' to replace the 'Boho Sunshine' variables with the new 'Noir Paws' palette. Keep the variable names if possible to avoid breaking admin, OR scope the new variables to a '.player-theme' class.
2. SCOPE STYLES: The user wants to focus on the PLAYER. Wrap the player app in a container with the new theme class/styles. Do not break the Admin dashboard.
3. UPDATE FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import for Fraunces, Manrope, and Special Elite to index.css.
4. REFACTOR PLAYER COMPONENTS: Go through the player-related components (Welcome, Tour, Unlock, etc.) and apply the new Tailwind classes defined in 'components'.
5. ADD TEXTURE: Apply the noise/paper texture to the main player background.
6. ENHANCE MOTION: Ensure page transitions are smooth. Use 'framer-motion' if available, or CSS transitions.
7. DATA-TESTID: Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
universal_guidelines: Use deep, rich colors for backgrounds, never pure black.
Make interactions feel physical and responsive.
